_meta.purpose: Capability-first discovery database for a programmatic video production toolkit. Grouped by CAPABILITY, not by repository, so multiple providers for one job are visible side by side.

evidence_levels.discovered: Seen in GitHub search / awesome lists / API metadata only. NOT opened.
evidence_levels.inspected: Repository cloned or tree+SKILL.md read via API. Read README, SKILL.md, and/or source structure.
evidence_levels.tested: Ran the tool's own gate (e.g. `npx hyperframes lint`) on its artifacts inside this sandbox and recorded the result.
evidence_levels.verified: Rendered output end-to-end and measured it. NOT achieved in this phase: sandbox cannot download Chrome headless-shell or ffmpeg (TLS reset to those CDNs), so no pixels were produced here.

sandbox_constraints_observed: Chrome/chrome-headless-shell download fails (TLS ECONNRESET) -> HyperFrames render/snapshot blocked.
ffmpeg absent from image and apt install denied (no root); npm tarballs for ffmpeg-static fail TLS verify.
raw.githubusercontent.com blocked -> HyperFrames registry add fails; `registry` must be an absolute https URL (file:// rejected). npmjs.org CDN works, so the CLI installs.
Consequence: every claim below about visual quality comes from the project's own docs/showcase or a third-party benchmark, not from our own render.
